title: Exploring Islamic local wisdom of halal tourism destinations toward return visits and the perception of Islamic socio-cultural responsibility
core_idea: Investigate how Islamic local wisdom and Islamic socio-cultural responsibility influence Muslim tourists' decisions to revisit halal tourism destinations, employing a qualitative phenomenological approach with interviews and observations at Indonesian halal sites.
tldr: A qualitative phenomenological study probing the role of Islamic local wisdom and socio-cultural responsibility in shaping Muslim tourists' revisit intentions to halal destinations in Indonesia.
